basics.name: Abizeyimana Victor Iradukunda
basics.headline: Engineering Manager · Platform Engineering · Digital Infrastructure
basics.summary: Engineering Manager and platform engineering leader with 11+ years building digital infrastructure for government and enterprise service digitization. I translate policy, operational, and integration requirements into secure, configurable transaction platforms while leading engineering teams and remaining hands-on with architecture, distributed systems, workflow automation, production reliability, and AI-assisted delivery.

featured.title: What forward deployed engineering is teaching us about shipping services that work
featured.description: Irembo TechTalk on connecting discovery, executable prototypes, delivery, release, and stabilization.

work.summary: Lead multiple engineering teams delivering digital infrastructure for government and enterprise services across workflow automation, systems integration, data migration, and production reliability.
highlights: Directed the digitization and production launch of 25+ government and enterprise services, then scaled change delivery and operational support across 75 live digital services

Made integrations easier to configure and operate through idempotent configuration imports, scheduled jobs with run history and recovery controls, endpoint discovery, and capability-based access control
Strengthened platform stability through event-processing improvements, bounded PostgreSQL retention, trace propagation, failure handling, and a measured API failure-rate reduction of more than 99%
Implemented low-code/no-code form and workflow automation with schema validation, Model Context Protocol integrations, automated AI evaluation, and deployment automation

work.summary: Progressed from public-service platform delivery into reusable low-code/no-code infrastructure, then assumed engineering-lead scope before promotion in September 2025.
highlights: Built the first version of a low-code/no-code form and workflow automation platform with portable configuration reusable across environments
Delivered production workflows across identity, justice, education credentials, civil registration, and account security with zero post-release defects or incidents in the reviewed delivery record
Digitized 15+ business-registration services through configurable workflows, integrations, certificates, pricing rules, and client-driven changes
Built reusable containerized deployment tooling and demonstration stacks for international solution workshops, and trained 10+ engineering interns in four weeks
